program.name: Bar Four-Day
program.subject: Pull-ups
program.blurb: Four days round the bar: wide pulls, chin-ups and arms, legs, then core and push.
program.about: Four days that treat the bar from every side. Wide-grip pulls and rear shoulders one day, chin-ups and arms the next, then a leg day, then hanging core work with presses. Straight sets throughout. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
program.split: Wide pulls / chin-ups & arms / legs / bar core & push
